mapper.update: UPDATE shared_translation_cache SET detected_source_language = NULL, translated_text = NULL, status = 'PROCESSING', lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, retry_after = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE AND ( (status = 'PROCESSING' AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= #{now})) OR (status = 'FAILED' AND (retry_after IS NULL OR retry_after <= #{now})) OR (status = 'READY' AND translated_text IS NULL) )
